blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The newly appointed commissioner of the Presidential Commission for the Urban Poor (PCUP) has drawn scrutiny from the public for her fashion-forward lifestyle and lavish trips abroad, which appear to contrast sharply with her role at the agency. Zofia Canlas, who was sworn in as PCUP commissioner at 27 years old, graduated with a degree in biology from De La Salle University in 2024.
